description: This file contains the implementation of a Text-to-Speech (TTS) speaker component, including configuration handling, pipeline management using GStreamer, and client interaction logic for speech synthesis. It manages speaking states, resource allocation, error handling, and media pipeline creation for audio output.

classes.name: TTSConfiguration
classes.description: Handles configuration parameters for the TTS engine, such as endpoints, voices, language, volume, and fallback data. Provides methods to update and validate configuration, load/save from files, and manage fallback scenarios.

classes.name: TTSSpeaker
classes.description: Implements the core TTS speaker functionality, including pipeline creation with GStreamer, speech queuing and processing, error handling, and resource management. Manages interaction with clients and controls media playback.

methods.name: TTSSpeaker::createPipeline
methods.description: Creates and configures a GStreamer pipeline based on the specified pipeline type (MP3 or PCM), adding necessary elements, linking them, and setting up bus watch for message handling.

methods.name: TTSSpeaker::destroyPipeline
methods.description: Cleans up and releases GStreamer pipeline resources, stopping pipeline playback and removing bus watch.

methods.name: TTSSpeaker::resetPipeline
methods.description: Resets the current pipeline by stopping and rebuilding it if necessary, or clearing error states.
